text: a railway platform in the monsoon
a houseboat on the Kerala backwaters
a Himalayan bus stop in fog
a terrace on kite festival day
a lighthouse at the edge of the map
a greenhouse full of strange plants
a garden on a space station
the top berth of a night train
a hostel room the night before exams
a bookshop with a sleepy cat
a Ferris wheel at a village mela
a metro carriage at rush hour
a Goa beach out of season
a tea estate in Darjeeling mist
a promise kept against the odds
a letter that was never sent
a race against a ticking clock
a found object that unlocks a memory
an outsider who finds a home
one moment seen by three people
a small act that ripples outward
a goodbye that becomes a beginning
